newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open lower as U.S. election weighs.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open lower as U.S. election weighs.

text.p: UK shares edged lower in early trading on Tuesday amid continued nervousness ahead of the U.S. elections, traders said.

A mixed bag of company results provided little direction and few positive surprises to lift the cautious mood in London. Marks & Spencer added to the downbeat tone as a disappointing set of first half figures pushed the shares 12-1/2p lower to 496-1/2p at the start of trading.
Shortly after the open, the FTSE 100 was down 3.0 points at 3,925.1 though traders said the downside was likely to be limited with investors staying on the sidelines.
